---
title: "wrapped fixture: page-wide columns"
filters:
  - wrapped
format:
  html: default
  pdf:
    keep-tex: true
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    fig-format: png
  docx: default
---

In HTML, a wrapped figure in a page-wide column keeps its normal layout,
with a warning. In PDF through LaTeX it does so where Quarto makes the figure
page-wide. It wraps in PDF through Typst and Word.

## A fig-column page cell

```{r}
#| label: fig-page-cell
#| fig-cap: "A fig-column page cell figure."
#| fig-column: page
#| classes: wrap-right
#| out-width: !expr if (knitr::pandoc_to("docx")) "5in"
plot(1:10)
```
